objectives.label: Watch the market of {settlement} at night and catch {name}

title: Thief-taker
The market thief
summary: Things go missing from the stalls of {settlement} after dark. {giver} wants the thief caught — alive.
offer: Every morning the stallholders find something gone: a purse, a bolt of cloth, a ham. Watch the market tonight, catch the thief, and bring back what they took. Alive, mind — the court wants a word.
complete: Caught at last. The stallholders will sleep tonight.
